items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Ever know anybody named Pratt? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. That's to be Chris Wright Man, Banjo Man.

ctx.x: He didn't play at all. Just happened to have. He bought the horn. He pretended to play it, but he somehow or other didn't make no way with it, so he sold it to me for five dollars.
Yeah. That's to be Chris Wright Man, Banjo Man.
